Kill [[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Jarimiya the Unmerciful in the [[Vehtendi Valley]].
* *BONUS* Kill Jarimiya in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Proceed west from [[Yahnur Market]], down the hills, across several bridges and into the plains area near the center of [[Vehtendi Valley]]. Note that this boss is near several patrols of other [[Heket]], including other bosses. It is possible to get to this boss while avoiding the other groups.

Alternately take the easier route, heading south into [[Forum Highlands]] from [[the Kodash Bazaar]] and hugging the eastern-most wall, where you will only have to fight 1 to 3 [[mob]]s of heket. Continue south through the [[portal]] into Vehtendi Valley. Head south, around the slope and Jarimiya is directly ahead of you.
